mapper.select: SELECT id, title FROM chapters ORDER BY chapter_number

SELECT c.chapter_id AS chapterId, e.action, e.answer_status AS answerStatus, e.attempt_no AS attemptNo, e.hint_used AS hintUsed, e.created_at AS createdAt, e.session_id AS sessionId, e.step_index AS stepIndex FROM classroom_events e JOIN classroom_sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id JOIN classroom_scripts c ON c.id = s.script_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, source_path AS sourcePath FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE source_path LIKE 'textbook/lessons/%'
SELECT chapter_id AS chapterId, title, payload_json AS payloadJson, created_at AS createdAt FROM animation_records WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT chapter_id AS chapterId, source_code AS sourceCode, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM code_runs WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT s.chapter_id AS chapterId, m.content FROM chat_sessions s JOIN chat_messages m ON m.session_id = s.id AND m.role = 'user' WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT title, source_path AS sourcePath FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND source_path LIKE 'textbook/lessons/%' ORDER BY source_path
